subject: Purchase order clearing delay — request for temporary eval access
messages:
From: Hannah Liu <hannah.liu@bellwetherhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: temporary eval hold — PO processing delay

Hi Priyom,

Quick note from procurement: our PO for Redwood is routed but stuck in a final sign-off queue with our legal team — estimated clearance now pushed to the end of the month. The pilot team still needs uninterrupted API access to finish the integration tests. Can Redwood provide a short-term accommodation (temporary credits or extended trial) while the PO clears?

Attaching a note from our procurement system with the expected timeline. Appreciate a quick confirmation of what you can do so we can keep momentum.

Best,
Hannah Liu
Head of Procurement, Bellwether Health
procurement@bellwetherhealth.com

Attachment: po_status_note.txt (text)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Liu <hannah.liu@bellwetherhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary eval hold — PO processing delay

Hi Hannah — thanks for the transparency and the timeline.

We can absolutely help keep the pilot live. Proposing a short-term credit allocation so your engineers can continue validating the integration while procurement finalizes the PO. Before I commit anything, I need a quick internal approval from my manager (looping in Lauren).

If approved, we typically grant:
- A time-limited credit (example: 10k tokens / 14 days) or
- Temporary API access with throttled quotas until PO clears

Two quick asks from your side so we process this faster:
1) Confirm the PO ETA you mentioned (end of month)
2) A contact in finance to send an informal confirmation (helps our approvals)

I’ll follow up once Lauren flags approval.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary eval hold — PO processing delay

Priyom — reviewed. Approve a limited accommodation given the account stage. Please issue a 14-day "keepalive" credit package with clear expiry and usage caps. Record the approval and attach the small internal approval PDF.

Terms I approve:
- 10,000 token credit
- Valid from issuance until 2026-11-30 23:59 PST
- Auto-expire; no carryover
- Only for API usage tied to BW-2026-045 pilot endpoints

Attachment: trial-credit-approval.pdf (internal approval)

Keep the ask minimal and confirm when you send it.

-Lauren
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@bellwetherhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary eval hold — PO processing delay

Hannah — thanks, Lauren approved a short-term accommodation. Details below and attached:

What we issued:
- 10,000 token trial credit applied to account (deal: BW-2026-045)
- Valid through 2026-11-30 23:59 PST
- Rate limits applied to prevent misuse (we can relax if you ask)

Next steps for you:
- Confirm ETA of full PO (end of month ok?)
- If finance needs anything, please have them email me or reply-all and we’ll surface the internal approval doc.

I’ve attached the approval PDF and a copy of the PO draft you shared for our records. Also linking the HubSpot deal and the DocuSign stub for signatures.

Related links:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/67890
- DocuSign (signature stub): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123

Attachments: trial-credit-approval.pdf, purchase-order-draft.pdf

Regards,
